title: A bijection Hom(A,-) -> Hom(B,-) natural in the target is precomposition with a unique isomorphism B -> A (co-Yoneda)
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and $A,B$ objects of $\mathcal C$. Suppose given, for every object $X$ of $\mathcal C$, a bijection $\Phi_X:\mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(A,X)\to\mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(B,X)$, natural in $X$: $\Phi_{X'}(g\circ f)=g\circ\Phi_X(f)$ for all $f:A\to X$ and $g:X\to X'$. Then $\theta=\Phi_A(\mathrm{id}_A):B\to A$ is an isomorphism, $\Phi_X(f)=f\circ\theta$ for every $X$ and every $f:A\to X$, and $\theta$ is the only morphism $B\to A$ with this property. (Stacks, Categories, Lemma 001P (categories-lemma-yoneda), applied to the opposite category $\mathcal C^{\mathrm{opp}}$: the functor $U\mapsto\mathrm{Hom}(U,-)$ is fully faithful.)
